title: Recommended reference_call table and handoff schema store recordings + full verbatim transcripts with no retention or deletion limits
detail: The recommended ReferenceCallResult schema and reference_call table persist referee voice recordings and full transcripts (third-party personal data; legal.md itself notes transcripts can carry incidental special-category data) with no retention period, purge rule, or redaction step. legal.md defers minimisation to a future DPIA, but the schema recommendation that would be implemented is silent, conflicting with the GDPR storage-limitation principle the same documents invoke.
recommended_fix: Add retention/deletion fields and a recommended policy to the schema and reference_call table (e.g. auto-delete recording after N days, retain structured result + transcript only, redaction pass for incidental special-category data before storage).

title: Schema stores a Twilio recording URL as the access path to referee audio; default Twilio media URLs are unauthenticated bearer links
evidence: +      "recording_url": null               // Twilio recording SID/URL when consented
detail: Twilio recording media URLs are fetchable without credentials unless the account enables 'Enforce HTTP Auth on Media URLs'. Persisting the URL as written makes each stored URL effectively a bearer link to a referee's voice recording, visible in any DB export, log line, or admin panel that surfaces the row.
recommended_fix: Store only the recording SID, fetch media server-side with account credentials (or enable Twilio's HTTP-auth-on-media setting), and serve audio to landlords through an authenticated app endpoint.
